title: ChipCytometry for multiplexed detection of protein and mRNA markers on human FFPE tissue samples
protocol: Cut 4–5 μm tissue sections and place them on 24 mm coated coverslips.
Let the tissue sections dry for at least 12 hours at room temperature (RT).
Incubate dry sections 12-16 hours overnight at 60°C in a dried oven.
Increase the incubation temperature to 70°C for 30 minutes the next day.
Incubate sections 3 times for 10 minutes each in Xylene at RT.
Incubate sections twice for 10 minutes each in absolute Ethanol at RT.
Incubate in 90% EtOH for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate in 70% EtOH for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate in 50% EtOH for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the coverslips in tap water.
Transfer the coverslips from tap water into pre-heated retrieval solution.
Incubate for 20 minutes at 90°C.
Remove the coverslips from the antigen retrieval solution and transfer them to a jar filled with PBS at room temperature.
Incubate in H2O2 for 10 min at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Wash with 10 mL H2O.
Incubate with Sudan Black B for 10 min at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Carefully rinse coverslip with 1 mL 70% EtOH [10 times].
Wash with 10 mL PBS.
Hybridize probes for 2 h at 40°C according to instructions of the RNAScope multiplex fluorescence kit.
Wash with RNAScope wash buffer.
Place a wet tissue paper in the incubator underneath the sample slides and cover it with a lid to create a humidified chamber.
Wipe off any liquid from the coverslip that is not covering the tissue itself.
Remove the adhesive film from the ZellSafeTM tissue chip.
Transfer the coverslip to the chip, ensuring that the whole tissue is located within the visible window of the chip.
Gently press together the chip and the coverslip to assure that the system is leakproof.
Rinse the chip with 5 mL 5× Sodium saline citrate (SSC) buffer and remove any air bubbles.
Scan background of the tissue with the ChipCytometry microscope while it is in 5× SSC buffer.
Rinse the chip with 10 mL wash buffer.
Follow the instructions of the RNAScope in situ hybridization kit for signal development.
Rinse the chip with 5 mL PBS.
Acquire signals in the corresponding channels with the ChipCytometry microscope.
Rinse the chip with 5 mL quenching buffer.
Incubate 30 min under white light at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Exchange buffer every 5 min to avoid formation of air bubbles in the chip.
Rinse with 20 mL PBST.
Proceed with cyclic immunofluorescence via ChipCytometry.
Wipe off any liquid from the coverslip that is not covering the tissue itself.
Transfer the coverslip on the ChipCytometry chip according to manufacturer’s instructions ensuring the whole tissue is within the visible window of the chip.
Rinse the chip with 5 mL PBS and remove any air bubbles.
Add 500 μL of 5% goat serum in PBST into the chip.
Incubate for 1–2 h at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Rinse with 1 mL PBS five times.
Add 500 μL 0.1% Sudan Black B solution into the chip.
Incubate for 10 min at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Rinse with 1 mL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 1 min at 21°C–24°C (RT).
Wash gently with 1 mL of 70% ethanol, wait 1 min twice.
Wash faster with 1 mL of 70% ethanol, wait 1 min twice.
Repeat the washing procedure if there are visible components of the Sudan Black B solution still inside the chip.
Rinse with 1 mL PBST [3 times].
Force liquid flow by pushing PBST through the channel.
Rinse with 1 mL PBST, wait 1 min [3 times].
Prepare 300 μL antibody master mix per chip containing all antibodies in titrated concentration, mix by pipetting [10 times].
Centrifuge master mix for 10 min at 16.000 × g (or max speed) at 4°C to remove dye or antibody aggregates.
Transfer 290 μL of the mix into the chip without touching the bottom of the tube.
Incubate 8-14 hours at 4°C (shorter incubation times are possible depending on the epitope).
Rinse the chip with 20 mL PBST.
Acquire the signal in the dedicated channels using the ChipCytometry microscope.
Photo bleach each position for 20 seconds using the ChipCytometry microscope.
Wash the chip with 5 mL PBST.
Repeat steps until all markers have been stained on a chip (refer to Table 2 for validated markers).
Pause point: After bleaching and washing, the chip can be kept at 4°C for several months.
If the chip is stored for more than seven days, rinse with 2 mL Zellkraftwerk Storage buffer.
